newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy fuel use by generating sector falls in June.
newsitem.headline: Italy fuel use by generating sector falls in June.

text.p: Consumption of fuel oil by Italy's power generating sector fell 17.6 percent in June year-on-year to 1.64 million tonnes, data from trade group Unione Petrolifera (UP) showed.
In the first half 1997, consumption by the sector fell 13.4 percent to 10.03 million tonnes, UP said in a statement.

UP data showed that one percent sulphur fuel oil accounted for 1.27 million tonnes in June, a 16.0 percent drop on June 1996, and in the January-June period posted a fall of 12.8 percent to 7.75 million tonnes.

In June, total national consumption of petroleum products was down 2.2 percent on June last year to 7.2 million tonnes. In the first six months, consumption of petroleum products fell 4.1 percent to 45.4 million tonnes on the first half last year.
